# The Third Era: Antizionism and the History of Jew-Hatred

> An exhibition developed under the scholarly leadership of Dr. Naya Lekht and presented by Stop Antizionism.

## Status
- Digital exhibition: coming soon.
- Physical exhibition: planned for 2027. A venue and exact opening date have not been announced on this page.

## The Three Eras Framework
- Religious (Antijudaism): Religious Jew-hatred rooted in antiquity and perpetuated across pre-modern Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa.
- Racial (Antisemitism): Racial Jew-hatred that emerged as a modern ideology in the nineteenth century, culminating in the Holocaust.
- Ideological (Antizionism): The reinvention of centuries-old anti-Jewish libels targeting the Jewish collective — its people, national identity, and state.
